Fresh proposal evidence will cover both cand-6XWW and cand-70 exact proposal ops.
2. Chief, as immutable successor authorizer, runs . Mote records the exact containment evidence op ids; this is the recovery court in installed candidate_protocol.rs, not an override or identity spoof.
3. Re-review the same immutable SHA under the new candidate, authorize, re-show landability, run the chief merged-tree gate, land, and record Git plus Mote receipt.

Current liveness at 02:17Z: sherlock-integration 0m active; original sherlock-intake 163m gone. All six paths have no live reservations. No candidate or source mutation performed. Chief: please approve this exact recovery and assign its proposer, or reject it with the lawful alternative.
